About our shopping links.

Current status: no Amazon Associates tracking IDs are enabled. We earn no commission from the shopping links currently on this website.

What the links open

Our USA and Japan buttons open ordinary Amazon search pages. Results are controlled by the store and may include items we have not evaluated. A search link is not an endorsement of every result, seller or claim shown there.

If affiliate links are introduced

After the relevant Associates account is established, qualifying links may earn a commission. We will identify paid links close to the link, explain the relationship clearly and display the applicable required program disclosure. A US account or tracking ID will not be assumed to cover Japan.

How we handle product information

We do not copy Amazon customer reviews, display Amazon logos, invent discounts or publish live prices. The guides currently contain no product ratings or claims of firsthand tests. Product specifications and shopping conditions should be verified on the current manufacturer's and seller's pages.

Independent publication

Deskwise Guide is not owned, operated or endorsed by Amazon. Store names are used to identify shopping destinations. Our editorial aim is to make your buying decision more informed, including when that means keeping what you already own.
